content_capture.title: Models & Pricing
facts: deepseek-v4-pro is an available API model and reports model version DeepSeek-V4-Pro.
The model supports thinking mode and JSON Output at the standard API base URL.
USD prices per million tokens are 0.003625 for cache-hit input, 0.435 for cache-miss input, and 0.87 for output.

content_capture.title: Thinking Mode
facts: OpenAI-format requests enable thinking with a thinking object whose type is enabled.
reasoning_effort accepts high or max, and regular thinking requests default to high.
Temperature and related sampling controls do not take effect in thinking mode.

content_capture.title: JSON Output
facts: JSON Output is enabled with response_format type json_object.
The prompt must explicitly request JSON and show the desired JSON structure.
Empty content can still occur and truncated JSON is possible when the token limit is reached.

content_capture.title: Create Chat Completion
facts: The response reports model, finish_reason, reasoning_content, content, system_fingerprint, and token usage.
prompt_tokens equals prompt_cache_hit_tokens plus prompt_cache_miss_tokens.
Documented finish reasons include stop, length, content_filter, tool_calls, and insufficient_system_resource.

content_capture.title: Error Codes
facts: Documented client-side categories use HTTP 400 for invalid format, 401 for authentication failure, 402 for insufficient balance, and 422 for invalid parameters.
Rate-limit, internal-server, and server-overload responses use HTTP 429, 500, and 503 respectively.
The official handling guidance for HTTP 429, 500, and 503 is to wait briefly and retry.

content_capture.title: Returns to Buying Winners and Selling Losers: Implications for Stock Market Efficiency
facts: The paper studies cross-sectional continuation using past relative stock performance.
Its reported continuation is horizon-dependent and later partly dissipates.
The historical result is evidence to question, not a guaranteed relation in A shares.

entries.authored_summary: 相对价格表现可能包含阶段性的延续信息，但效应具有期限和市场依赖。候选应把趋势作为可证伪的状态变量，并避免把单一累计收益机械复制为结论。

content_capture.title: Fads, Martingales, and Market Efficiency
facts: The study examines short-interval return predictability and winner-loser reversal.
It discusses thin trading, bid-ask effects, and plausible transaction costs as competing explanations.
Short reversal is conditional evidence rather than a universal law.

entries.license_or_usage_basis: NBER citation metadata and abstract facts only; no paper full text is stored or prompted.
entries.authored_summary: 短期极端相对表现可能随后反转，但微观结构、流动性和成本会混淆信号。候选应寻找能区分暂时偏离与持续趋势的历史量价状态。

content_capture.title: The Extreme Value Method for Estimating the Variance of the Rate of Return
facts: The paper motivates using intraperiod high and low prices to characterize return variance.
Range information can carry volatility information not present in a single close-to-close change.
A volatility estimator is not by itself a prediction of expected return.

entries.license_or_usage_basis: DOI citation metadata and short method facts only; no paper full text is stored or prompted.
entries.authored_summary: 历史高低价区间可以补充收盘变化对风险状态的描述，但波动状态与未来横截面收益的方向必须由数据检验，不能由估计方法直接推出。

content_capture.title: Illiquidity and stock returns: cross-section and time-series effects
facts: The paper relates price response to traded value as a rough illiquidity concept.
It separates expected illiquidity compensation from contemporaneous unexpected illiquidity effects.
The original measure uses traded value, which is outside this first arm's allowed fields.

content_capture.title: Price Momentum and Trading Volume
facts: The paper studies whether past trading volume conditions the magnitude and persistence of price momentum.
It treats price and volume jointly rather than assuming volume has one unconditional meaning.
Its long-horizon empirical findings do not establish causality or transfer automatically to A shares.
